data_limitations: No historical provider-vintage archive; retrospective corrected dataset
Fixed selected funds, not survivorship-free all-ETF or constant-sector universe
No independent opening-auction volume or spread history
Displayed prices rounded to 0.01; reconstructed pre-split ticks can have 0.02 increments
Reported Yahoo volume divided by future split factor, a conservative capacity assumption; volume basis not independently verified

paired_uncertainty.interpretation: Circular time-block bootstrap interval for arithmetic mean paired monthly return difference; descriptive small-sample uncertainty, not proof of alpha.
